_design: Contract C-1 - CANONICAL ONTOLOGY. The common vocabulary every component (C1 extraction / C2 process-mining / C3 intervention / C5 delivery) keys on: `domain x dimension`. Before this file the two source registries disagreed (capability_model.json = 15 domain keys, domains.json = 18 functional keys) and were reconciled by FUZZY TOKEN-MATCHING at build time (build_brain_state.py `_norm()` + set intersection). This file makes the mapping EXPLICIT and the crossing a LOOKUP. It ADDS a vocabulary layer - it does NOT rename anything in the source stores and does NOT add or remove dimensions.
_authority: READ-ONLY contract, hand-versioned. `dimensions` is a verbatim copy of capability_model.json:.dimensions - capability_model.json stays the single source of truth for the MATRIX (cell values); this file is the source of truth for the VOCABULARY (which keys are legal and what they mean).

_strata.note: A domain is a PAIR, not one model. The product lives in the delta. Capability G = compare AS_RUN against AS_DESIGNED. Conformance has TWO preconditions per domain: the standard baseline AND our process. Capturing AS_DESIGNED per domain is itself a precondition capability (S_STANDARD_REF below), mostly NONE today.
_strata.AS_DESIGNED: how SAP designed the domain — normative reference flow/objects/config as delivered (SAP Best Practices / PaPM reference content)
_strata.AS_RUN: how UNESCO actually does it — real process from data + Z-code/config/exits/.NET apps/workflows on top
_strata.DELTA: G_CONFORMANCE — where AS_RUN extends/deviates from AS_DESIGNED, down to the implementing object (the custom-over-standard x-ray)

_resolution_rules: EXACT match only - no token matching, no fuzzy fallback. A key resolves iff it is a canonical_key, a declared alias, a subdomain_aliases key, or a cross_cutting_keys key.
An alias resolves to exactly one canonical_key (the index is checked for collisions at load).
A canonical_key may carry several aliases (Payment_BCM -> Payment, BCM): every matching L14 registry entry receives that row's capability_coverage.
cross_cutting_keys are NOT domains. They resolve so the gate is green on today's data, but they are reported separately and the list is FROZEN: any new unregistered value fails.

E_AUTH.question: who can/does execute it (roles, users, SoD)?
E_AUTH.method: VERIFIED (RES-AUTH-SOD wwyujjqyk): role model AGR_DEFINE/AGR_USERS(validity)/AGR_TCODES/AGR_1251(obj+field LOW/HIGH)/AGR_AGRS/AGR_1016; users USR01/02/04/12, UST12; SU24 proposals USOBT_C(values)+USOBX_C(OKFLAG N/X/Y); TSTCA(start-tcode auth). SoD = Function(tcodes+auth objects) -> Risk(2+ conflicting functions), 3 risk types (SoD/Critical Action/Critical Permission), action+permission levels. Expand AGR_USERS->AGR_1251 for effective role auth. CAVEAT: SU24/USOBX_C is a PROPOSAL, not enforcement — real check only where code has AUTHORITY-CHECK (pair with code scan / ST01-STAUTHTRACE). GRC: 3-tier function->action->permission, risk header GRACSODRISK(RISKTYPE), ruleset COMPILED. REFUTED: exact '5 GRC tables' enumeration + GRACSODRISK-as-violations.
E_AUTH.split_d01_p01: role STRUCTURE (AGR_DEFINE/AGR_1251/USOBT_C/TSTCA) = D01 -> ROLE-level SoD without P01; user ASSIGNMENTS (AGR_USERS/USR02/UST12) = P01 -> USER-level SoD gated

U_USAGE.question: WHAT objects actually execute, WHO runs them, by which CHANNEL (dialog / batch / RFC-BAPI / batch-input BDC), WHEN, and at what VOLUME — the AS-RUN execution footprint?
U_USAGE.method: Fuse the execution-evidence channels into a per-domain object×actor×channel×time×volume census: RSAU/SM20 audit (Transaction Start->tcode, Report Start->program, RFC Function Call->function) + TBTCO/TBTCP (batch program+variant) + APQI/APQD (batch input / BDC). Cross-reference the static catalog (TSTC / TFDIR) to split EXECUTED vs CATALOG-ONLY. Builder: process_mining/fm_executed_census.py (generalize per domain via the FM-style name filter). Scored: NONE=no census; PARTIAL=one channel or counts-only; HAVE=all 4 channels with actor+volume(+time).
U_USAGE.note: The AS-RUN usage layer. Distinct from B_CODE (STATIC: which code exists), A_PROCESS (the FLOW/variants) and E_AUTH (who CAN execute). U_USAGE = who ACTUALLY executes what, how, when, how much. Bridges static inventory -> live reality; the dead-vs-used signal also feeds R_S4_READINESS (used-to-migrate vs dead-to-delete). Added 2026-06-23 on user directive ('otra dimension del process discovery: que se usa, quien, como, cuando, volumen').
